name: David A. Lamb
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Attorney David A. Lamb is a partner with Sherr Puttmann Akins Lamb PC law firm in Greenwood Village, Colorado. A nationally ranked lawyer with more than 25 years of total legal experience, Mr. Lamb focuses his practice primarily on family law, and he provides exceptional counsel and support to clients across his region who are going through a divorce or have some other serious legal challenge affecting their families.

Early in his legal career, Mr. Lamb served as Senior Deputy District Attorney, where he gained invaluable experience prosecuting child abuse and domestic violence matters. Although very comfortable in the courtroom, he prefers to use mediation and negotiation to help his clients resolve their conflicts and reach favorable agreements in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible.

Whether inside or outside the courtroom, Mr. Lamb maintains an unwavering focus on protecting his clients' rights and best interests, as well as those of their children, and he routinely acts as guardian ad litem in domestic and juvenile cases. In honor of his remarkable professionalism and service, Ms. Lamb has earned consistent recognition from The Best Lawyers in America, along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers.

After graduating with special distinction from The University of Oklahoma in 1993, Mr. Lamb attended Northwestern University School of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 1996. A leader in his field, he has written extensively and conducted lectures and continuing legal education seminars on a variety of legal topics, and he regularly appears on a local radio news program, where he offers in-depth legal commentary on various subjects.

Mr. Lamb holds his license to practice in Colorado and Illinois, and he is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado. He is also an active member of the Douglas, Denver, Arapahoe and Colorado Bar Associations, the Colorado Bar Association's Family Law Section, the Colorado Judicial Institute, and the Metro Denver Interdisciplinary Committee.
